opportunity-scout-delivery-(morning).name: Opportunity Scout Delivery (morning)
opportunity-scout-delivery-(morning).description: 9:30 AM daily — sends whatever the 02:00 research run queued, if anything. No research. Cheap by design; most days it finds nothing.

side-income-delivery-(morning).name: Side-Income Delivery (morning)
side-income-delivery-(morning).description: Sunday 9 AM — sends the message the 01:00 analysis run queued, if there is one. No research. Cheap by design.

opportunity-scout-research-(overnight).name: Opportunity Scout Research (overnight)
opportunity-scout-research-(overnight).description: 9 AM and 3 PM daily — rotate one research avenue (AI-work listings, fractional market, exec-search/board, LatAm ecosystem, events/deadlines, bet re-verification), verify adversarially, surface only findings that pass the full evidence bar. Silent runs are the norm.

maren-v0-launch-digest.name: Maren V0 Launch Digest
maren-v0-launch-digest.description: Daily 4:00 PM Bogotá (5 PM ET) — Maren V0 launch status to the assistant channel: done count vs required pace, PRs waiting on Amaury's merge, stuck tickets, Jira↔GitHub mismatches. Temporary job; retire after Maren V0 ships.

side-income-analysis-(overnight).name: Side-Income Analysis (overnight)

passive-income-discovery-scan.name: Passive Income Discovery Scan
passive-income-discovery-scan.description: Daily 3 AM — silent outside-signal scanner. Writes 0-3 filtered candidates to memory for the passive-income loop to consume. Never notifies Amaury directly.

career-market-weekly-digest.name: Career Market Weekly Digest

weekly-vp-performance-edge.description: Mondays 7 AM — one tactical VPE tip before weekly goal review.

daily-todo-digest.description: Personal-assistant morning digest: surface today's todos + execute the doable subset

slack-watch.name: Slack Watch
slack-watch.description: Read-only Slack watch — silent unless something genuinely needs Amaury (alarm-only mode)

pr-follow-up-check.name: PR Follow-up Check
pr-follow-up-check.description: Weekday morning check for PRs with unaddressed change requests

goal-progress-reconciliation.name: Goal Progress Reconciliation
goal-progress-reconciliation.description: Nightly auto-reconcile of goal task progress against agent activity and implemented suggestions

passive-income-state-consolidation.name: Passive Income State Consolidation

passive-income-research-loop.name: Passive Income Research Loop
passive-income-research-loop.description: Research tick (4x/day) driving P8 — see passive-income agent system prompt

pr-reviewer.name: PR Reviewer
pr-reviewer.description: Automated code review of open PRs every 30 min during work hours

weekly-team-shipping-report.name: Weekly Team Shipping Report
